valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on 9M 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 4.15 against price over EPS 4.48) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation behind every multiple of this security carries no price date, so the price each multiple divides is not a dated figure and the multiple cannot be audited. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation behind every multiple of this security carries no price date, so the price each multiple divides is not a dated figure and the multiple cannot be audited. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 4.15 against price over EPS 4.48) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
